content:
maria: Heads up — since 06:00 UTC we've seen ~120 ECC/Xid alerts from dcgm-exporter in eu-west1, concentrated on 3 nodes. Alert spam is drowning SRE pager :sob:
kevin: I saw that. lots of short spikes, likely transient hardware flutters. Current prom rule fires immediately per-card.
sara: Can we gate by a rolling count + node-level cooldown? e.g. only fire if ecc_errors_total increases >2 in 5m on same GPU.
alex: +1. also add a per-node 'recently-drained' label so we don't re-alert while a node is draining.
maria: proposal: 1) new recording rule "gpu_ecc_err_rate_5m" as a sum_over_time, 2) alert when >2 AND last_alert_at(node,gpu) >15m via redis lock, 3) Alertmanager dedupe route by node+gpu.
kevin: putting redis lock in alert pipeline (webhook) seems okay, but prefer pushing suppression logic into Alertmanager using external inhibition API? risky.
sara: here's a recording rule sketch:
```yaml
- record: infra:gpu_ecc_errs:sum5m
  expr: sum_over_time(dcgm_dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]) by (instance, gpu)
```
then alert:
```yaml
alert: GPU_ECC_Flurry
expr: infra:gpu_ecc_errs:sum5m > 2
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "GPU {{ $labels.instance }}/{{ $labels.gpu }} ECC spike"
```

alex: That helps reduce one-off spikes but doesn't prevent repeated alerts during remediation.
devon: What if we annotate the node with `maintenance=true` when we start a drain, and add an Alertmanager mute rule for nodes with that label?
maria: Good — adding both annotation-based inhibition + webhook redis dedupe for cross-region storms.
oncall-bot: ALERT: GPU_ECC_Flurry fired on node gpu-az2-04 (3/5 cards) — see https://alerts.company/12345
kevin: Can ops add a small `ecc-watchdog` ETL that posts the last seen ecc count into Redis TTL 20m, webhook checks TTL before forwarding to pager.
sara: Also worth adjusting dcgm-exporter scrape interval for those flaky nodes to 15s, to avoid missing short bursts.
alex: runbook tweak: prefer `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=10m node/<name>` and wait 2m before manual RMA decision.
maria: I'll open a PR with the recording rule + alert + Alertmanager route. I'll also draft a webhook that returns 200 and suppresses if redis TTL exists.
kevin: ping me on PR, can help with redis lock code and helm chart.
sara: After we merge let's run a synthetic job that emits 3 ecc errors on a test node and verify only one pager hit.
alex: :eyes: thanks all, agreed on next steps.
